import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);command=json.loads(sys.argv[2]);marker=root/"run/Rprof.out"
assert not marker.exists()
child=subprocess.Popen(command,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
deadline=time.monotonic()+20
while child.poll() is None and not marker.exists() and time.monotonic()<deadline: time.sleep(.01)
assert child.poll() is None and marker.exists(), "No live CPU processing window observed"
assert os.getpgid(child.pid)==os.getpgrp() and os.getsid(child.pid)==os.getsid(0)
argv=["/usr/bin/sample",str(child.pid),"5","1","-mayDie","-file",str(root/"run/native-sample.txt")]
started=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
sample=subprocess.run(argv,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=15,check=False)
exit_code=child.wait(timeout=120)
p=root/"run/native-sample.txt"
record={"started_utc":started,"finished_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"r_command":command,"r_pid":child.pid,"group":os.getpgrp(),"session":os.getsid(0),"sampler_argv":argv,"sampler_exit":sample.returncode,"r_exit":exit_code,"processing_marker":"Rprof.out appeared while the owned R child was live","sample":{"path":str(p),"bytes":p.stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} if p.exists() else None}
with (root/"native-sample-observation.json").open("x") as stream:json.dump(record,stream,indent=2,sort_keys=True);stream.write("\n")
sys.exit(exit_code or sample.returncode)
